text:
alex (docs): Quick thread - updating the Rate & Quota guide with a compact migration checklist and new SDK snippets (Py/TS/Go). PR: https://rwd/pulls/5102. Need reviews on headers, code accuracy, and a fallback note for private clusters.

maria (sdk): I'll review. Heads-up: Hosted returns X-Quota-Org; private deploys surface X-Tenant-Quota. Recommend doc shows both and encourages using /quota feature-detect.

jin (product): Add a short paragraph explaining how burst credits behave: multi-tenant -> per-org; dedicated -> pool-level with tenant tagging. Keep it clearly illustrative (non-contractual).

ori (analytics): Also add a troubleshooting callout: "tokens vs requests" — many customers see token consumption from embeddings but zero request counts. Suggest example that prints both.

alex (docs): Draft Python snippet I added to PR (short):

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="${REDWOOD_KEY}")
q = c.quota.get()
print(q.tokens_left, q.requests_left)
if q.requests_left>0:
  r = c.generate(model="rw-medium", prompt="status")
  print(r.id, r.quota_left)
```

maria (sdk): Small fixes: use snake_case fields (tokens_left, requests_left, quota_left) and avoid blocking calls in examples without context. I'll push a tiny edit.

alex (docs): Thanks. Also adding a one-line fallback showing header checks for X-Quota-Org / X-Tenant-Quota when /quota isn't available.

maria (sdk): For JS, use client.quota.get().then(...) example; for Go, keep it minimal and show error handling. I'll add both.

jin (product): Could we include an illustrative tiny table: Tier | Monthly quota | Burst credits ? Keep numbers sample-only.

ori (analytics): Paste the Grafana panel permalink? We should not link internal panels directly in public docs. link-bot, can you run the link-checker?

link-bot: link-check: https://grafana.internal/consumption?panelId=99177 returned 403. Recommend screenshot artifact or a public mock link.

alex (docs): I'll attach a sanitized screenshot to the PR and add caption: "internal panel - screenshot for illustration; use permalink when embedding in private consoles".

maria (sdk): One more nit: avoid referencing X-Rate-Limit-Remaining — it's deprecated in meter v2. Call out migration step: replace header checks with /quota or X-Quota-Org/Tenant.

alex (docs): Adding a short migration checklist at top: 1) audit header usage 2) switch to /quota or new headers 3) update SDKs 4) validate dashboards.

jin (product): +1. Please mark the PR with :white_check_mark: when ready and we'll merge after CI and screenshot.

ori (analytics): +1

maria (sdk): +1 - will push small edits now.
